Fixed in c2b53d6. Chromium was installed globally, exposing 9 real failures behind the missing-binary issue this bead originally tracked. Root cause for most: playwright.config.ts webServer.url only waited for Vite (:1420), not the Rust backend's HTTP bridge (:17373), which starts later on a cold cargo build. Fixed via a new global-setup.ts gate, a second webServer entry for the :8765 static form server, waitForDesktopApp's retry budget bumped 10s->45s, and test.describe.serial() + an explicit form-snapshot POST for llm-matching.spec.ts's stateful phases. Also required a real product fix: apps/extension/src/background.ts GET_DESKTOP_STATUS was returning a cached, up-to-60s-stale isDesktopAvailable instead of a live check, and several extension-popup.spec.ts offline-simulation tests were mocking the wrong scope (popupPage.route() instead of context.route()) and had only ever passed by accident. Verified: npx playwright test x6 consecutive runs, 46 passed/5 skipped/0 failed every time; pnpm test/typecheck/build all pass at repo root; apps/extension unit tests 91/91 unaffected.
